top_signals.title: China’s Inflation Cools as Iran War Oil Shock Starts to Ease
top_signals.summary: China’s factory-gate inflation eased for the first time since the Iran war broke out in late February while consumer prices also decelerated, in another sign that cost pressures from the oil shock are starting to fade.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: BOJ summary flags upside price risks, possible faster hike pace
top_signals.summary: At its July meeting, the BOJ held its policy rate at 1% and signaled it could possibly raise it in September, saying it's watching the weak yen's impact on prices and growth.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
